title: A Letter for the Ledger Revisited
author: Beatrix Yarrow
blurb: Isandro Kavanagh, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
